tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live US nursing and allied-health job openings by location, role, specialty, shift, pay and requirements. Data is refreshed daily from employer career sites. Each result has a one-line summary, structured pay, a listing_url to show the person, and an apply_url that goes straight to the employ

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details for one job from search_jobs: description text, requirements, pay, apply link and similar jobs.

tools.name: get_pay_benchmarks
tools.description: Typical posted hourly pay (25th percentile, median, 75th percentile) for a healthcare role nationally and, optionally, in a state, metro or specialty. Use it to tell someone whether an offer is competitive.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Valid roles, specialties, settings, employment types and shifts (with aliases and job counts) for search_jobs.
